observations.name: Invalid JSON file shows syntax error and preserves original input
Actual file above 1.2 MB rejected while preserving input and clearing file selection
Valid file replaces payload, clears error and leaves save available
Selecting the same file again rereads it and replaces manual temporary text
Loaded but unsaved JSON still uses explicit discard protection
Malformed replacement preserves previously loaded valid result
Mobile JSON error and retained result fit 390px viewport
Opening another task shows its own clean context after discarding first task input
Loaded file for other task is still rejected by context validation without erasing payload
Valid result saves to intended task after retries

limits: Actual browser file selection exercised malformed, oversized, valid, repeated, wrong-task and final successful submission.
No forced slow browser File.text, in-flight close action or I/O read failure; deferred helper and callback reproduction are distinct Node checks.
No code integration, generated app execution or test record created in this fixture.
